title: Losing the Fish Was What He Was Looking For

meta.name: v5_k18_09_the-fish
meta.title: Losing the Fish Was What He Was Looking For

lines.text: Losing the fish was exactly what he was looking for.
Mūsā and his servant travel on with a fish.
But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away.

quran.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَا مَجۡمَعَ بَیۡنِهِمَا نَسِیَا حُوتَهُمَا فَٱتَّخَذَ سَبِیلَهُۥ فِی ٱلۡبَحۡرِ سَرَبࣰا

lines.text: That is what we were seeking. So they returned, following their footprints.

quran.ar: ذَ ٰ⁠لِكَ مَا كُنَّا نَبۡغِۚ فَٱرۡتَدَّا عَلَىٰۤ ءَاثَارِهِمَا قَصَصࣰا

lines.text: The thing they lost was the clue.
